rules.hubs: concept linked to ≥ 2 plants by live sourced claims
rules.variation: same plant + facet, two claims with different stated conditions (or cultivar equal) and non-overlapping values
rules.disagreement: same plant + facet + same conditions (or none stated), different sources, non-overlapping values; ordinal facets only for categorical values
rules.gaps: (a) plant with no live claim on a gate facet; (b) plant–concept link with one source; (c) two plants sharing ≥ 5 concepts with no live relation
rules.single_voice: concept whose links all come from one source type
